title: Cinder
author: Marissa Meyer
summary: In a futuristic New Beijing, Cinder is a cyborg mechanic living with a cruel stepmother while a deadly plague spreads. When her path crosses with Prince Kai, she is pulled into a conflict with the Lunar queen.
readIf: you like fairy-tale retellings that swap glass slippers for spaceships and androids.
skipIf: you want a standalone, since this is the first of a series that continues.

pairings.reason: A lighter, more traditional take on a familiar Cinderella story, with a cursed heroine.
Another YA story about a girl and a prince, in a more dystopian setting.
A tenser YA with power struggles and a heroine hiding a secret.
